facts.fact: StackAdapt's integration with LiveRamp lets advertisers in the US and UK onboard and activate CRM audiences within 30 minutes to a few hours, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: gives advertisers in the US and UK direct access to onboard and activate Customer Relationship Management (CRM) audiences within 30 minutes to a few hours

facts.fact: StackAdapt claims to be the first self-serve demand-side platform in the US and UK to make LiveRamp's RampID retrieval API directly accessible to platform users.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is the First Self-Serve Demand-Side Platform in the US and UK to Make LiveRamp’s RampID Retrieval API Directly Accessible for Platform Users.

facts.fact: Advertisers can upload CRM data including emails, names, phone numbers and postal addresses through the StackAdapt UI, which are matched to create a new segment within 30 minutes to a few hours.
facts.quote: Advertisers can upload their CRM data, including emails, names, phone numbers and postal addresses through the StackAdapt UI and have it matched to create a new segment within 30 minutes to a few hours.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's description of LiveRamp's process, LiveRamp removes personally identifiable information and replaces it with pseudonymous record keys during matching.
facts.quote: LiveRamp removes personally identifiable information (PII) and replaces it with pseudonymous record keys during the matching process

facts.fact: LiveRamp's people-based identity graph is described by the vendor as the largest omnichannel graph on the open internet, enabling device-level targeting based on deterministic data.
facts.quote: LiveRamp’s people-based identity graph—the largest omnichannel graph on the open internet—enables StackAdapt to provide device-level targeting based on deterministic data

facts.fact: The press release is dated May 20, 2020 and was updated June 20, 2022.
facts.quote: **Toronto, ON and San Francisco, CA – May 20, 2020**, **updated June 20, 2022**
